name: Hashentic for WooCommerce
author: Hashentic

sections.description:
Hashentic gives every item you sell a unique, verifiable identity. Customers scan the QR code or tap the NFC tag with their phone and see at once whether the product is genuine. You see where and when your products are checked, and Hashentic flags clones and grey-market sales.

  • Unique codes per order. When an order with a protected product is paid, every item gets its own code. Print them on the packing slip from the order screen.
  • Secure NFC tags. With NFC on, tags are written with the Hashentic mobile app when the order is packed. NTAG 424 DNA tags sign every tap, so copied tags are detected.
  • Code batches. Issue codes for stock you label before it is sold, and download them as CSV.
  • Verify authenticity block. An “Authenticity” product tab, or the [hashentic_verify] shortcode anywhere.
  • Digital product passport. Fill in materials, origin, care, safety and recycling data, publish a GS1 Digital Link passport page and show it with [hashentic_passport]. Optionally fill empty fields with AI.
  • Owner registration. Optionally, when an order with NFC-tagged items is completed, Hashentic e-mails the buyer one invitation for each tagged item to register as its owner. Off by default; it needs a Hashentic plan with product ownership and invitations turned on for the store in Hashentic.
  • Refunds and cancellations. Codes of cancelled or refunded items are released automatically; issued codes stay valid for items already delivered.

Hashentic service

This plugin connects your store to the Hashentic service, which issues and verifies the codes. You need a Hashentic account: create one from the plugin (a free trial is included) or connect an existing account with a connection key from the Hashentic admin panel. Hashentic plans are billed by Hashentic directly; the plugin itself is free and all of its screens and settings are available on every plan. Some service features, such as NFC tags and AI suggestions, depend on your Hashentic plan, and every plan has monthly limits.

  • Service: hashentic.com
  • Terms of Service: hashentic.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: hashentic.com/privacy-policy

External services

This plugin relies on the Hashentic service, provided by XORDEX VENTURES Sp. z o.o. It is needed to issue, store and verify the authenticity codes and to publish product passports. Nothing is sent until you act: when you click “Create account” in WooCommerce → Hashentic, the plugin asks https://slv.hashentic.com for the current Terms of Service version (no store or personal data is sent); when you paste a connection key, the plugin checks it with your Hashentic account. Everything else is sent only after the store is connected or a sign-up is started. Terms of Service: https://hashentic.com/terms. Privacy Policy: https://hashentic.com/privacy-policy.

  • Your Hashentic account (the address in your connection key, for example https://yourbrand.hshntc.com): titles, image addresses, brand and variation names of the products you protect; for paid orders with protected products the order id, order number, ordered products and quantities; refunded quantities; passport data you enter; when you click “Fill empty fields with AI”, the product name and description (up to 4,000 characters), which Hashentic passes to the AI provider named in its Privacy Policy. No customer names, addresses or payment data are sent, and no customer e-mail addresses except for owner invitations.
  • Owner invitations (only when “Invite buyers to register as owners after the order is completed” is on in WooCommerce → Hashentic and Hashentic accepts invitations for the store): when an order with NFC-tagged products is completed, the order id, the buyer’s billing e-mail address and the order language (two letters), sent once per order, so that Hashentic can e-mail the buyer one invitation for each tagged item to register as its owner. The request is sent only to the Hashentic account and store connection that was active when the order was completed, and never again with a changed billing e-mail. When you erase a customer’s personal data with the WordPress tools, the plugin asks Hashentic to delete the order references and the invitation.
  • Sign-up (https://slv.hashentic.com): the e-mail address you enter, the code from the confirmation e-mail, the store address and name, and the admin language, to create the account; while the account is being created the plugin asks for its progress. Hashentic then calls https://your-store/wp-json/hashentic/v1/site-proof once to confirm the plugin runs on that address.
  • Storefront. The “Verify authenticity” link and the product passport link point to your Hashentic account. When the passport block shows the responsible business and safety information, the shopper’s browser loads that public passport data from your Hashentic account.

When a customer scans a code, Hashentic records the time, the approximate location derived from the IP address and the device type to detect counterfeits. The plugin adds a suggested paragraph to Settings → Privacy.

Third-party code

assets/js/vendor/qrcodegen.js is the QR Code generator library by Project Nayuki, MIT licence (https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library), as included unchanged in qrcode.react 4.2.0 (ISC licence). Source code: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/master/typescript-javascript
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Open WooCommerce → Hashentic.
  3. Either create a Hashentic account with your e-mail address, or in Hashentic open Applications → WooCommerce store, enter your store address, create a connection key and paste it here.
  4. Edit a product, open the Hashentic tab and tick “Protect with Hashentic”.
sections.faq:
When are order codes created?

When the order is paid (status Processing), or when it is completed if you choose that in WooCommerce → Hashentic. Orders on hold get codes only when they reach that status.

What happens on a staging copy of my store?

The plugin remembers the address of the store it was connected on. On another address it pauses all calls to Hashentic until you confirm that the store moved, so a staging copy never changes your live data.

Does the plugin work with HPOS and the block checkout?

Yes. It supports High-Performance Order Storage and the cart and checkout blocks.

How do buyers become owners of their items?

Turn on owner invitations for the store in Hashentic under Applications → WooCommerce store, then tick “Invite buyers to register as owners after the order is completed” in WooCommerce → Hashentic. When an order with NFC-tagged items is completed, Hashentic e-mails the buyer one invitation for each tagged item. Fully refunded items get none. Mention in your privacy policy that the buyer’s e-mail address is shared with Hashentic for this; the suggested text under Settings → Privacy covers it.

Where are the codes printed?

Each order has a “Hashentic codes” box with a printable packing slip. Batches can be downloaded as CSV for your label printer, or printed as labels in the Hashentic admin panel.
